checks: 19 exact native tests twice debug/release; repeated syntax; three compiled source mutants
cost: Let L be lattice cost, T tipping cost, P points, D enabled devices, S present status pairs<=6. flags costs O((1+2D+S)L+T+P*E+F log F) plus strings; E is evaluate cost and F emitted flags.
description: Deterministic fixed-scale flags over rule paths and counterfactual cases.
forward: Build lattice/honest path; inspect purpose via narrow reading and devices; inspect reachable severity gaps, unresolved principle ties, one-reading flips and six status swaps; sort descending score then kind/what and deduplicate.
inverse: For admitted finite cases, excluded outputs include a status-only flag with equal compared severities, a disproportion flag with gap<3, or mutation of the caller case. This inner source-derived exclusion is about the fixed algorithm, not moral or legal validity.

A flag output admits every case/jurisdiction whose actual lattice traces trigger the same criterion and rendered chain. Observing only kind/score forgets rules, witnesses and text, hence many compatible antecedents; no recovery of a unique real-world case.
Given a reached winning verdict severity v>=1 and fixed harm h, gap abs(v-h) maps3->2,4->3,>=5->4; below3 no disproportion flag. Check harsh/fair synthetic fixture.

reason_in_case splits semicolons then ': ', drops listed stopwords and accepts any Sure-covered verb/patient/argument value. Thus a single matching token suffices; it does not test all reason clauses.
swap_status swaps agent/patient/colon argument values/persons in both directions, preserving verbs, places and text. With distinct words, applying twice is identity on the edited fields.

Output order sorts descending score, ascending kind, ascending what, then adjacent equal full Flag records dedup. Equal text with different chains can survive; no claim of one flag per semantic event.
limitations: Partial source-derived models and finite correspondence only
No live parser/corpus/frozen gold or protocol filesystem effects; no percentage surrogate
state: Finite synthetic rule/case states; valid indices, bounded paths, successful allocations. No legal authority claim.
